dutyRateBasis: Canada HS 9405.11.00 (electric lighting fittings designed for LED) / 9405.19.00 (other), MFN column, 7%. Canada applies no Section 301 equivalent to these goods - its surtaxes on Chinese imports cover electric vehicles, steel and aluminium - so MFN is the entire stack. The deeper difference from the US is the BASE: this 7% is charged on VALUE FOR DUTY, which is the supplier price, where the US charges its 41.4% (HTS 9405.11.80) on retail. About CA$2.04 a unit against US$40.57.
verdict: Priced at CA$84.99, CA$9.57 over the CA$75.42 amazon.ca band median and CA$1.74 under the CA$86.73 RULE 2 ceiling. Contributes CA$21.96/unit on the wholesale basis (7% MFN on value for duty) at the LIST cost of C$42.57 plus C$2.82 freight, against the CA$16.23 floor. At the pendants' shared CA$74.99 it files under the floor, so it takes CA$84.99 like the tiered pendant, the nest and the column. Rule 22: the page sells at C$40.02, a 6% gap under the C$42.57 originalPrice, so the list is the cost basis.
